_note: On or near a trodden hoe path (Dave 3 and 4 Nov 2026, QA answer 7): while a path patch has its centre within range_m of the player, the pace is multiplied by these (walk +20 percent, jog +15, run +10) and the effort the server counts from the player's speed is multiplied by exertion_factor, so it costs less strain than the same movement off the path. Tune here. The client reads the speed factors, the server reads exertion_factor and range_m.
